regime_context: The TSX theme board shows a broad, two-headed leadership structure: Base Metals & Copper narrowly ahead of Oil & Gas Producers, both with momentum scores well above the next tier, and 9 of 16 themes trend-eligible (broad, non-directional rotation). The absolute-trend gate has validated drawdown-control value on this market's history, so trend discipline is supported; the theme momentum rank itself is a focus lens only. The macro backdrop is thin and coincident (markets/geopolitics narratives, 40% unscheduled share).
emerging_watch: Watch Big Banks (ZEB.TO): score 0.7, rank 5, eligible, and the only top-5 theme with a 'trend' hurst_tag and durability_bar 0.6 — if its breadth rises above ~0.45 and it overtakes Silver & Royalties in rank for two consecutive prints, leadership may be broadening into financials.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: XBM.TO is the leader by a thin margin over XEG.TO, is trend-eligible, and not crowded. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge (drawdown/shake-out control), so an overweight lean on the eligible leader is defensible as a trend-following hold. However, hurst_tag 'mean-revert' and a modest 0.056 margin over the challenger undercut trend persistence. Momentum rank itself is a focus lens, not alpha, so conviction stays low.
theses.dissent: The hurst_tag is mean-revert, not trend, so the recent leadership may already be mean-reverting; and the margin over Oil & Gas is only 0.11, suggesting fragile leadership vulnerable to a shake-out rather than a durable trend.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO lags XEG.TO by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is ranked 2, trend-eligible, not crowded, with the highest breadth of the top tier (0.571) and a 'mixed' hurst tag (not clearly mean-reverting). Durability_bar 0.61 is the highest among leaders, suggesting slightly better staying power than Base Metals. Same logic applies: the gate is drawdown control, not a return forecast, so this is a hold lean with a focus on trend discipline rather than alpha expectation.
theses.dissent: Oil is a macro-driven cyclical; unscheduled surprise share is 40% and the macro backdrop is geopolitics-heavy, meaning headline risk can gap this theme regardless of momentum. The leading challenger position also risks being only a rotation artifact with no confirmed handoff.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day average and stays there for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: XRE.TO ranks 15 of 16, is not trend-eligible (eligible=false), has the second-lowest score (-1.29) and lowest breadth among scorable themes (0.083), with a 'trend' hurst_tag indicating the downside move is persistent. Given the validated edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate, a non-eligible, low-breadth, persistent-trend-down theme should be avoided until it regains eligibility.
theses.dissent: REITs are a rate-sensitive rate-cut beneficiary; if the macro backdrop shifts dovish (not in this state), deeply discounted REITs could snap back hard. Avoid is a risk-discipline call, not a return forecast, and may miss a sharp mean-reversion rally.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO regains trend eligibility (eligible=true) and ranks in the top 5 for two consecutive weekly prints before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
